Carlos — thanks, received and reviewed the attachments (quick scan looks good). Two quick next steps from procurement side:

1) Micro-deposit verification: our payments team will push two small micro-deposits to the ACH account for verification within 24–48 hours. Can you confirm someone will be monitoring the account and reply once you see them? We use this as final proof-of-account ownership.

2) PO appendix / invoice labeling: procurement needs you to confirm that your invoices will include the remittance string exactly as you specified (PO + vendor code + invoice id). To avoid delays, we require the first invoice to include the PO number in the invoice header and the remittance string in the payment details section.

Cc'ing Priyom and Marissa to create the PO and attach the vendor code to the record. Priyom — please create PO PO-2027-SS-4821 and add the vendor tag VND-SS4821; mark for net30. Marissa — can you add onboarding checklist item: verify micro-deposit and upload bank letter to the vendor file after confirmation?

If you prefer, we can also accept a bank-signed letter of authorization on your company letterhead in lieu of micro-deposits — let me know.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
